text:
alex: Noticed some Dedicated clusters failing key unwrap yesterday after RBAC refactor. Lots of 403 from kms-service. Root cause looks like role mappings weren't applied to service-account tokens rolled out at 03:00 UTC. Excerpt of logs:

```
2026-03-18T03:12:07Z ERROR kms-client: decrypt: permission denied: principal \"svc-prod-ingress\" missing kms.decrypt
```

maria: Thanks. Do we have a quick mitigation? Some customers impacted in EU region.

kevin: Quick workaround: grant kms:decrypt to the affected service-account via console or run:

```
redwoodctl iam grant --principal svc-prod-ingress --perm kms.decrypt --scope project:acme
```

irene: We're rolling a policy hotfix that re-adds the old 'svc-*' wildcard mapping. Can we avoid permanent wildcard? We should patch SDK codepath too.

sam (security): +1 on avoiding wildcard. Proposed fix: revert mapping rollout, then apply a targeted role-binding for service account groups and update audit logs to capture who created the role. I'll put a runbook step.

rbac-bot: Policy release 2026-03-18T03:05 UTC: RBAC v2 mapping applied -> 72 services changed. See /policies/rollouts/179005.

alex: Revert started at 03:40 UTC. ETA 10-15m.

maria: After revert, a few customers still saw 403. Could be cached tokens with claim 'rbac_v2:deny' present. How to force re-issuance?

kevin: Tokens are short-lived (15m), but short-term workaround: restart the ingress pods to get fresh tokens. Or run `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress -n acme`.

irene: For longer-term, SDK change required: rbac client used `evaluate()` but the role mapping field name changed from `allowed_roles` -> `role_refs` and we missed a backward-compat check. Patch in PR #842 will add backward compat and log a clear audit event when mapping name mismatch.

sam (security): Add these to the incident timeline and mark as P2. Also add steps to audit log for KMS decrypt failures: filter path `audit.kms.*` and search for \"permission denied\".

alex: Docs updates: internal RBAC FAQ and KMS integration pages need examples showing new `role_refs` mapping and guidance for service accounts. I'll draft a short note and ping content.

maria: Can we alert on spike of kms:decrypt denies? ops-alerts team: please add threshold (>=10 in 5m) and runbook link.

ops-alerts: acked, creating alert rule now -> ARC-553.

kevin: SDK note for devex: change in Python SDK v1.9: `rbac_client.map_roles(mapping)` now accepts `role_refs` and will warn if `allowed_roles` present. Please update changelog.

alex: Postmortem owners: sam + irene. Follow-ups: 1) Policy validation tests in CI 2) SDK compatibility tests 3) Docs + runbook 4) Alerting. I'll open tickets.

maria: Thanks everyone. Customer comms draft in #customer-success after we confirm rollback and patch.

rbac-bot: Policy revert complete at 03:56 UTC. Rollback id 179005-revert. Audit log ingest path: /audit/policy/179005/revert.

alex: Closing thread when we have postmortem link.
